items.question: How does Lovart's pizza menu creator work?
items.answer: Simply describe your pizzeria and menu offerings, including pizza styles, signature items, crust options, additional food categories, and your restaurant's atmosphere. Our AI Design Agent creates custom menu designs that strategically showcase your pizza offerings. You can then refine the designs through conversation until they perfectly align with your brand identity and sales goals.

items.question: What makes Lovart different from template-based pizza menu creators?
items.answer: Unlike rigid templates that force your unique pizzeria into generic designs, our AI creates completely custom menu layouts specifically for your restaurant. The system understands menu psychology and pizza industry best practices, creating designs that strategically highlight your specific offerings rather than forcing your items into a one-size-fits-all template that wasn't optimized for increasing pizza sales.

items.question: Can I create different menu versions for different purposes?
items.answer: Absolutely!
